   **Bugs and stability.**
      16 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Apr 20, 2026 - Nov 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _The Salty Apple_, Nov 22, 2026, 1/5: "I love the desktop version, but as I’ve been using it more and more, I was hoping to start bringing Notion on the go with me. Unfortunately the app on my iPad won’t even open. And on my iPhone it’s not much better. I have the most up to date version. It’ll open the loading screen but crash before any of my pages load. I’ve never gotten it to open on my iPad. And even when it opens on my iPhone, it’s buggy and will only open the simplest pages without crashing. But the second I click between pages, it crashes. Guess it’s back to google docs for me."
            2. _BlA387532_, Sep 24, 2026, 1/5: "The amount of times it glitches is absolutely uncanny. And that for 700€+ per year. Currently looking for an alternative."
            3. _vevenissa_, Oct 2, 2026, 2/5: "The app is absolutely amazing in itself but for god’s sake please fix the bugs. My app crashes at least once a day and I use it daily for note taking in lectures. It becomes such a hassle when the app refuses to let me type anything mid lecture and i miss very important info. I’m considering using other apps despite Notion being so handy for organization."
